hypothesis: An extreme short-term daily pullback against an established XAU trend can mean-revert over the next few sessions with enough amplitude to cover Ostium costs.
inspiration_not_evidence: Classic short-RSI trend-pullback concept; all rules, grid and evidence are newly preregistered here.
predecessor_role: Independent mean-reversion mechanism; no candidate, performance or tuned parameter from v9 is reused.

fixed_structure.long_setup: signal close above EMA and Wilder RSI at or below the registered extreme
fixed_structure.short_setup: signal close below EMA and Wilder RSI at or above 100 minus the registered extreme
fixed_structure.exit: ATR catastrophe stop or close after 1/2/3 sessions
fixed_structure.position_policy: one open position per strategy; signals while a position is open are ignored

representative_selection.adjacency: one grid step in exactly one non-side parameter
